messages.subject: Is gdbsource() working on Mac OS?
parts:
Has anyone tried runtime debugging with "gdbsource()" on Mac OS? (my impression
is that mac people are using the "clang" compiler, so I am a bit confused)

I am not using Mac myself, but I am working on developing a run-time debugging 
tutorial (as part of a set of case studies):

https://github.com/skaug/tmb-case-studies
